description: Create a post. Creates a draft, or a scheduled post when scheduled_at is set (ISO-8601 with offset; a bare local time is read in the account timezone). Upload media afterwards with POST /posts/{id}/media, then publish or schedule. Rules: TikTok-only posts cannot be a carousel or story and carry no first comment or comment auto-reply; scheduling needs a caption (stories excepted) and a future time; the plan's monthly cap counts scheduled and published posts, a plain draft never holds a slot; a comment auto-reply on a scheduled post needs a free live comment-trigger slot (403 plan_limit_reached). tiktok.privacy_level must be one of the creator's options from GET /posts/capabilities.

collaborators.description: Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators. Instagram only.

comment_auto_reply.description: Becomes a comment trigger scoped to this post when it publishes. Instagram and Facebook only.

buttons.description: At least two for any DM mode.

cover_offset_ms.description: Reels: which frame is the cover.

first_comment.description: Posted under the post right after publish. Instagram and Facebook only.

platform.description: A target set. both = Instagram + Facebook; all = all three.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601. Null on PATCH turns a scheduled post back into a draft.

tiktok.description: TikTok settings. Ignored unless TikTok is a target.

content_disclosure.description: The "promote yourself or a third party" disclosure. When true, set promote_self and/or promote_third_party.

privacy_level.description: Must be one of the creator's options from GET /posts/capabilities.

title.description: Defaults to the first 150 characters of the caption.

name: create_post
